items.label: Powerful Performance for Work & Study
items.value: Powered by the AMD Athlon Silver 3050U processor and 16GB DDR4 RAM, this laptop delivers reliable performance for everyday multitasking. Whether you're working, studying, browsing, or video conferencing, it provides smooth, efficient operation without slowdowns.

items.label: Fast PCIe SSD Storage for Quick Response
items.value: The 512GB PCIe SSD ensures fast boot-up, rapid file access, and smooth app performance. Compared with traditional drives, it delivers shorter loading times and a more responsive experience, ideal for students, professionals, and everyday users.

items.label: 15.6” FHD IPS Display with Anti-Glare
items.value: Enjoy crisp visuals on a 15.6-inch Full HD IPS display with wide viewing angles and an anti-glare coating. Whether working indoors or studying under strong lighting, the screen stays clear and comfortable for long hours of productivity.

items.label: Enhanced Connectivity with Wi-Fi 6 & Full Ports
items.value: Stay productive with Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.2 for faster, more reliable wireless connections. A full set of ports—including USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, RJ-45 Ethernet, and an SD card reader—ensures easy access to monitors, networks, and external devices.

items.label: HD Webcam, Long Battery Life & Fast Charging
items.value: The 720p HD webcam with a privacy shutter and dual microphones ensures clearer, safer video calls. Up to 10 hours of battery life keeps you going through the day, while Fast Charge support provides quick power boosts when you need them.

items.label: Other Special Features of the Product
items.value: Anti Glare Coating, HD Audio, Numeric Keypad, Spill Resistant

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: External displays, mice, keyboards, storage devices, printers, and other accessories via USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, RJ-45 Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6, and Bluetooth 5.2
